title: API Partnership with Stack Overflow
summary: API Partnership with Stack Overflow Stack Overflow and OpenAI today announced a new API partnership that will empower developers with the collective strengths of the world’s leading knowledge platform for highly technical content with the world’s most popular LLM models for AI development.
body: API Partnership with Stack Overflow Stack Overflow and OpenAI today announced a new API partnership that will empower developers with the collective strengths of the world’s leading knowledge platform for highly technical content with the world’s most popular LLM models for AI development.
summaryZh: 与 Stack Overflow 的 API 合作 Stack Overflow 和 OpenAI 今天宣布建立新的 API 合作伙伴关系，该合作伙伴关系将为开发人员提供世界领先的知识平台的集体优势，以获取高技术含量的内容以及世界上最受欢迎的人工智能开发法学硕士模型。
